metadata.title: GridIQ benchmark gap-resolution register
metadata.rule: Unavailable Botswana operational measurements may be addressed for planning with published benchmark datasets, but the resulting values remain benchmark/modelled and never become BPC-observed truth.

gaps.missing: BPC line resistance/reactance and thermal ratings
gaps.application: OSM mapped 132/220/400 kV line geometry is enriched with conservative/reference/high-capacity R/X/current envelopes.
Voltage-transition sensitivity only; no benchmark type is relabelled as a BPC transformer.

gaps.benchmark: Eskom metering-based hourly RSA contracted demand; PyPSA-Earth GEGIS/DemandCast methodology as fallback reference
gaps.application: Only the normalized hourly shape is used, then scaled to published Botswana peak/annual-energy anchors. South African MW magnitudes are discarded.

gaps.benchmark: NASA POWER hourly irradiance + Botswana PVOUT annual screening benchmark
gaps.application: Temporal solar shape is derived from irradiance and calibrated to annual PVOUT; not measured plant output.

gaps.benchmark: NREL/NLR 2025 ATB + IRENA battery cost benchmark
gaps.application: Duration, round-trip efficiency and cost screening; not a procurement quote.

gaps.missing: Authoritative current sub-district polygon file in the bundled release
gaps.benchmark: Open Botswana administrative GeoJSON from Location Grid Project
gaps.application: Spatial display/join substitute only. The UI must say non-authoritative benchmark geometry.

gaps.missing: Verified current connection status for every gazetted village
gaps.benchmark: World Bank Botswana DRE settlement clusters + GEP electrification-planning indicators
gaps.application: Creates a settlement screening/candidate register. It cannot convert a modelled settlement into a verified BPC unconnected-village record.

gaps.benchmark: Official Botswana district cattle context + FAO cattle-dung biogas yield ranges
gaps.application: District evidence is shown as context; biogas volume is calculated only when explicit collectable manure mass is supplied. No district cattle are silently apportioned to villages.

gaps.benchmark: Topology structural criticality (bridges, articulation points, N-1 geometry islanding, edge betweenness)
gaps.application: Provides a maintenance/redundancy watch-list without predicting failure probability.

gaps.missing: Validated national operational injections/loads for congestion
gaps.benchmark: Explicit multi-injection benchmark DC power-flow using OSM geometry + standard electrical parameters
gaps.application: The E2 system-benchmark endpoint accepts balanced explicit/modelled injections and computes branch flows/utilisation/loss sensitivity. It is not current BPC loading.
